exposure: Preimplantation genetic testing (PGT) with trophectoderm biopsy
cohort: The study included participants undergoing 3373 intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) single frozen-thawed blastocyst transfer cycles, categorized by whether trophectoderm biopsy was performed.
finding: Preimplantation genetic testing with trophectoderm biopsy does not increase the risk of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, and can effectively reduce the rates of miscarriage and birth defects in ICSI single frozen-thawed blastocyst transfer cycles.
